name: Acceptance suite-3 test 61 - comments + trailing commas remain invalid JSON -> BLOCKED
note: docs/acceptance-suite-3.md Campaign A. JSONC (// comments, trailing commas) is NOT JSON. The engine must reject it with INVALID_JSON and must NOT silently strip comments/commas unless it advertises JSONC support (it does not). Paste and file import behave identically.
rationale: AWS accepts strict JSON for IAM policies; comments and trailing commas are not part of RFC 8259 JSON. A lenient parser that repaired JSONC could change the document's meaning silently. Failing closed with a syntax error - identically on paste and import - is the correct, predictable behavior. Ref: RFC 8259 (no comments; no trailing commas) + IAM JSON policy grammar.
